Nautilus|sup.identity: Engage tank. Staggering Blow (passive): his first attack on a target briefly roots it. Dredge Line (Q) throws his anchor: on an enemy, they're pulled toward each other; on a wall, Nautilus is pulled to the wall. Titan's Wrath (W) gives him a shield and makes his attacks deal damage over time around him, Riptide (E) creates three waves of explosions that slow, and Depth Charge (R) sends a shockwave that chases a target, knocking up enemies in its path, then launches and stuns the target.
Nautilus|sup.playstyle: Engage support with a huge amount of CC: anchor, passive root, slow and a targeted ultimate. He loses to tanks who win up close or counter-engage (Taric, Rell, Braum, Leona, Alistar) and crushes fragile supports (Yuumi, Xerath, Zyra, Pyke).
Nautilus|sup.early_game: At level 2, look for Q → attack (passive root) → E: your ADC follows up. Anchoring a wall also lets you escape or reposition. Don't throw Q through minions: it stops on the first one.
Nautilus|sup.level_1: Dredge Line (Q) first. After that, max Q first.
Nautilus|sup.level_2: Titan's Wrath (W). A shield during the engage, and damage over time with your attacks.
Nautilus|sup.level_3: Riptide (E). Full combo: Q → attack (root) → E → W.
Nautilus|sup.level_6: Depth Charge: targets a champion and can't be dodged; everything in its path gets knocked up too. Combo: R → Q → attack → E.
power_spikes: Level 6: targeted ultimate on the carry.
First resistance items: a durable frontline.
Teamfights: a chain of CC on one target.
Nautilus|sup.lane_plan: Constantly threaten the anchor and play with your jungler. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored): place them around dragon.
Nautilus|sup.trading: All-in: Q → attack → E → W, then R at level 6. Defense: R or Q on the diver, attack to root them. Back off against tanks who win the fight up close (Braum, Leona, Taric): don't engage while they have their abilities.
threats: Taric and Rell, the worst matchups.
Supports who block or turn your engage around (Braum and his shield).
mistakes: Engaging when your ADC can't follow.
Forgetting the free root from your first attack.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Engage once his hook and lantern are used.
matchup_notes.Leona: She engages too and holds up well: play around your jungler.
matchup_notes.Braum: His shield blocks your anchor: aim from another angle or wait until he's used it.
matchup_notes.Yuumi: Her ADC is alone: engage on them.
matchup_notes.Taric: His invulnerability cancels your engages: wait out his ultimate.

Nautilus|sup.mid_game: Place Control Wards, look for picks with Q and R, and protect your ADC.
Nautilus|sup.late_game: Frontline: R on the enemy carry, Q to engage or catch a diver. Chain your CC on the same target.
Nautilus|sup.ahead: Engage often and help your jungler control the map.
Nautilus|sup.behind: Play counter-engages: R and Q stop divers on your ADC.
Nautilus|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to chain your CC on key targets so your team can kill them.
Nautilus|sup.final_tip: Your first attack on each target roots it: after the anchor, always attack before casting another ability.
